name: com.eldritchgames.pawnsystem
description: Genre-agnostic pawn framework for Unity. A Pawn is any character in the world — player- or AI-driven — with identity, vitals, a movement seam, and a lifecycle covering spawn, death, revival, possession and release. The core has no input, ability or interaction dependency; optional adapter assemblies bridge it to the Eldritch Input System and Ability System.
